posts.trend: Dreaming of a Germany job? Indian engineer explains what a €70,000 salary looks like after taxes, rent & other costs
posts.context: Indian parents view moving to Europe as an automatic ticket to extreme wealth, oblivious to progressive taxes.
posts.angle: Your family thinks moving abroad is a Bollywood transition scene.
slides: Beta, Germany ka visa kab aa raha hai?

Sharma ji ka beta Berlin mein hai.
Ghar kab le rahe ho?
Settle ho jao ab.

You are thirty-one.

You have to explain why forty percent of your salary belongs to a government that does not speak English.
posts.caption: Settle ho jao. ✈️
posts.rank_verdict: An exceptionally strong post that executes the transition from family pressure to cold tax bureaucracy flawlessly.
